9:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s"."cdscode") AS "count_directly_charter_funded"
FROM "satscores" AS "sat"
JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "sat"."cds" = "s"."cdscode"
WHERE "sat"."rtype" = 'S'
  AND "sat"."avgscrmath" > 560
  AND "s"."fundingtype" = 'Directly funded';
13:
SELECT sch.phone
FROM (
    SELECT s.cds
    FROM satscores s
    WHERE s.rtype = 'S' AND s.numtsttakr > 0
    ORDER BY s.numge1500::float / s.numtsttakr::float DESC
    LIMIT 3
) top
JOIN schools sch ON top.cds = sch.cdscode;
325:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m."molecule_id") AS carcinogenic_nitrogen_count
FROM "molecule" m
INNER JOIN "atom" a ON m."molecule_id" = a."molecule_id"
WHERE m."label" = '+'
  AND a."element" = 'n';
279:
SELECT DISTINCT "m"."label"
FROM "bond" "b"
JOIN "molecule" "m" ON "b"."molecule_id" = "m"."molecule_id"
WHERE "b"."bond_id" = 'TR001_10_11'
276:
SELECT DISTINCT "c"."atom_id", "c"."atom_id2"
FROM "connected" "c"
JOIN "bond" "b" ON "c"."bond_id" = "b"."bond_id"
WHERE "b"."bond_type" = '#';
498:
SELECT DISTINCT st.translation
FROM cards c
JOIN set_translations st ON c.setcode = st.setcode AND st.language = 'French'
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Tendo Ice Bridge%';
417:
SELECT
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.type = 'expansion' THEN s.code END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT s.code)) AS percentage
FROM sets s
INNER JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setcode
WHERE st.language = 'Japanese';
345:
SELECT DISTINCT c.name, l.status
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.types = 'Artifact'
  AND c.side IS NULL
  AND l.format = 'vintage';
1533:
SELECT DISTINCT
    ym."customerid",
    ym."consumption"
FROM
    transactions_1k t
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON t."customerid" = ym."customerid"
WHERE
    t."productid" = 5
    AND (t."price" / t."amount") > 29.00
    AND ym."date" = '201208'
1529:
SELECT
    SUM(t."amount" * t."price") AS total_spent_all_time,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ym."date" = '201201' THEN ym."consumption" ELSE 0 END) AS total_spent_january_2012
FROM transactions_1k t
LEFT JOIN yearmonth ym ON t."customerid" = ym."customerid"
WHERE t."customerid" = 38508;
180:
SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 1983 AND 1987
  AND dist.a3 ILIKE '%east Bohemia%';
113:
SELECT DISTINCT c."birth_date"
FROM "loan" l
JOIN "account" a ON l."account_id" = a."account_id"
JOIN "disp" d ON a."account_id" = d."account_id"
JOIN "client" c ON d."client_id" = c."client_id"
WHERE l."amount" = 98832
  AND TO_DATE(l."date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_DATE('1996-01-03', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND d."type" = 'OWNER';
1365:
SELECT DISTINCT e."expense_description"
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "budget" b ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
WHERE b."remaining" = (
    SELECT MIN("remaining")
    FROM "budget"
);
1388:
SELECT 
    m."first_name" || ' ' || m."last_name" AS full_name,
    i."source"
FROM "income" i
JOIN "member" m ON i."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE i."amount" = (SELECT MAX("amount") FROM "income");
1359:
SELECT 
    SUM(b.amount) FILTER (WHERE e.event_name ILIKE '%Yearly Kickoff%') / 
    NULLIF(SUM(b.amount) FILTER (WHERE e.event_name ILIKE '%October Meeting%'), 0) AS ratio
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement';
1429:
SELECT DISTINCT e."event_name"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "attendance" a ON m."member_id" = a."link_to_member"
JOIN "event" e ON a."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE m."position" = 'Vice President'
  AND e."type" = 'Social'
  AND e."location" LIKE '%900 E. Washington St.%';
